Replace only the component confirmed failed through diagnostics. Avoid replacing the complete assembly when an individual service component can correct the concern. Available Service Components Part Number Description R8572790AA Air Suspension Compressor 68087233AA Air Suspension Valve Block 52124932AE Front Air Suspension Hose Assembly 52124934AE Rear Air Suspension Hose Assembly 68064343AC Air Suspension Reservoir 68087240AA Temperature Sensor 68041137AF Compressor Assembly Diagnostic Decision Tree Customer Complaint: Service Air Suspension Message / Sagging / Unable to Adjust Ride Height / Compressor Running Continuously.  Step 1: Retrieve and record all DTCs.  C15D9 (Low Air Mass): Perform air mass test, complete system fill, leak-down test, and leak source identification before compressor replacement.  C15A1 (Unable to Obtain Desired Ride Height): Verify ride height, perform leak-down test, inspect valve block, air lines, and air springs.  C1562-98 (Over Temperature): Inspect for excessive compressor run time, leaks, low air mass, and restrictions before condemning the compressor.  If a leak is found, repair the leak and verify operation before replacing the compressor.  If no leak is found, perform compressor functional evaluation.  If moisture is in the lines and valve block, then evacuate or replace lines.  Only replace the compressor when a defect is verified (internal leak, failed solenoid, weak output, seized motor, failed functional test, or electrical failure). If the condition persists after PMI, refer to Workshop Manual (WSM), Section 417-01 for normal diagnostics and repair as necessary outside of this article. For claiming, use causal part 15604 and labor operations 12651D and BCM.

The BCP controls several vehicle functions, including the windscreen wipers and air conditioning actuators. Low current flow may cause excessive current in parts of the BCP circuit board and damage the unit. If a fault occurs, the wipers or air flap controls may operate incorrectly or fail. A wiper failure is indicated by a yellow warning light and the “Windscreen wiper fault” Check Control message.
